```{=html}
<style>
/* ── Chords and Solfège: play notes, see what they are ─────────── */
#cs-root{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.25rem 1rem 4rem;color:var(--site-ink,#1e1c18);
  font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}
#cs-root *{box-sizing:border-box}
#cs-root.page-columns,#cs-root .page-columns{display:block!important;grid-template-columns:none!important}
#cs-root [hidden]{display:none!important}
#cs-root .cs-intro{border-left:3px solid var(--site-accent,#3fc2b4);padding-left:1rem;margin:0 0 1.5rem;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.6;max-width:680px}
#cs-root .cs-panel{background:var(--site-surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-radius:10px;padding:1rem 1.1rem;margin:0 0 1rem}
#cs-root .cs-panel h2{margin:0 0 .2rem;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600;border:0;padding:0}
#cs-root .cs-row{display:flex;gap:.7rem 1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;margin-top:.8rem}
#cs-root .cs-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.25rem}
#cs-root .cs-field label{font:600 .68rem/1 var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}
#cs-root select{height:2.2rem;padding:0 .6rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-radius:7px;background:var(--site-surface,#fff);color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:.92rem}
#cs-root .cs-check{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;font-size:.9rem;margin:0;cursor:pointer;height:2.2rem}
#cs-root .cs-check input{accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90)}
#cs-root .cs-btn{height:2.2rem;padding:0 .9rem;border:1px solid var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);border-radius:7px;background:var(--site-surface,#fff);color:var(--site-accent-text,#0a4f47);font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#cs-root .cs-btn:hover{background:var(--site-accent-bg,rgba(63,194,180,.12))}
#cs-root .cs-hint{margin:.6rem 0 0;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);max-width:70ch}

/* what you are playing */
#cs-root .cs-read{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:1rem 2rem;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:640px){#cs-root .cs-read{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
#cs-root .cs-chord{font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;min-height:1.15em;letter-spacing:.01em}
#cs-root .cs-chord small{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);margin-left:.5rem}
#cs-root .cs-sub{margin:.35rem 0 0;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);min-height:1.4em}
#cs-root .cs-ghost .cs-chord,#cs-root .cs-ghost .cs-sub{opacity:.55}
#cs-root .cs-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:.92rem}
#cs-root .cs-table th{font:600 .66rem/1 var(--font-mono,ui-monospace,monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);text-align:left;padding:.2rem .6rem .35rem 0;width:5.5rem;font-weight:600}
#cs-root .cs-table td{padding:.2rem 0;font-weight:600}
#cs-root .cs-table td > span{display:inline-block;min-width:2.9rem;margin-right:.3rem}
#cs-root .cs-key{margin:.2rem 0 0;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}

/* the keyboard */
#cs-root .cs-scroll{overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.3rem}
#cs-root .cs-kb{position:relative;height:11.5rem;min-width:660px;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;touch-action:none}
#cs-root .cs-k{position:absolute;top:0;padding:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:.1rem}
#cs-root .cs-k.w{height:100%;background:#fff;color:#2a2622;border:1px solid #bdb3a5;border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;padding-bottom:.45rem;z-index:1}
#cs-root .cs-k.b{height:62%;background:#2a2622;color:#f1ece4;border:1px solid #2a2622;border-radius:0 0 5px 5px;padding-bottom:.35rem;z-index:2}
#cs-root .cs-k b{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
#cs-root .cs-k i{font-style:normal;font-size:.68rem;line-height:1;opacity:.75}
#cs-root .cs-k.w.on{background:var(--site-accent,#3fc2b4);color:#06302b;border-color:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90)}
#cs-root .cs-k.b.on{background:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);border-color:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);color:#fff}
#cs-root .cs-k.root{box-shadow:inset 0 -5px 0 #d9566b}
#cs-root .cs-k.do:not(.on){background:var(--site-accent-bg,rgba(63,194,180,.12))}
#cs-root .cs-k.b.do:not(.on){background:#3b4a47}
#cs-root .cs-oct{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-top:.6rem}
#cs-root .cs-oct span{font:600 .78rem/1 var(--font-mono,ui-monospace,monospace);color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}
</style>
<div id="cs-root">
  <p class="cs-intro">Play notes and see what they are: the chord name, its Roman numeral, and every note named in solfège, scale degrees or Sargam. The names move to whatever key you set, so the same chord reads the same in any key. Play on the keys below, on the letter keys of your computer, or on a MIDI keyboard.</p>

  <div class="cs-panel">
    <h2>What you are playing</h2>
    <div class="cs-read" id="cs-read">
      <div>
        <div class="cs-chord" id="cs-chord" aria-live="polite">&nbsp;</div>
        <p class="cs-sub" id="cs-sub">Play a note, or a chord.</p>
        <p class="cs-key" id="cs-keyline"></p>
      </div>
      <table class="cs-table">
        <tr><th id="cs-solth">Solfège</th><td id="cs-sol"></td></tr>
        <tr><th>Notes</th><td id="cs-names"></td></tr>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="cs-panel">
    <h2>Keys</h2>
    <div class="cs-scroll"><div class="cs-kb" id="cs-kb" role="group" aria-label="Piano keys"></div></div>
    <div class="cs-oct">
      <button type="button" class="cs-btn" id="cs-oct-dn" aria-label="Octave down">&minus; Octave</button>
      <span id="cs-oct-lab"></span>
      <button type="button" class="cs-btn" id="cs-oct-up" aria-label="Octave up">Octave +</button>
      <button type="button" class="cs-btn" id="cs-clear" style="margin-left:auto">Release all</button>
    </div>
    <p class="cs-hint" id="cs-type-note"></p>
    <p class="cs-hint" id="cs-note" role="status"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="cs-panel">
    <h2>Set up</h2>
    <div class="cs-row">
      <div class="cs-field"><label for="cs-sys">Name the notes with</label><select id="cs-sys"></select></div>
      <div class="cs-field"><label for="cs-do">Key note</label><select id="cs-do"></select></div>
      <div class="cs-field"><label for="cs-home" title="A minor key keeps the Do of its relative major, so its home note is La. Roman numerals, scale degrees and Sargam count from the home note.">Major or minor</label>
        <select id="cs-home"><option value="major">Major</option><option value="minor">Minor</option></select></div>
      <div class="cs-field"><label for="cs-label">Label the keys</label>
        <select id="cs-label"><option value="both">Names and note letters</option><option value="sol">Names</option><option value="names">Note letters</option><option value="none">Nothing</option></select></div>
      <label class="cs-check" title="Click a key to turn it on and click it again to turn it off, so you can build a chord one note at a time."><input type="checkbox" id="cs-hold"> Hold notes</label>
      <label class="cs-check"><input type="checkbox" id="cs-sound" checked> Sound the notes</label>
      <label class="cs-check"><input type="checkbox" id="cs-type" checked> Play with the computer keyboard</label>
    </div>
    <div class="cs-row">
      <div class="cs-field"><label for="cs-midi">MIDI keyboard</label><select id="cs-midi" disabled><option value="">Not connected</option></select></div>
      <button type="button" class="cs-btn" id="cs-connect">Connect a MIDI keyboard</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script src="/apps/shared/soundfont.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/pitch-spelling.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/degree-names.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/chord-entry.js?v=4"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/musical-typing.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/harmony.js?v=24"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/bass.js?v=11"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/comp.js?v=25"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/catalog.js?v=33"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/drums.js?v=15"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/congas.js?v=2"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/sounds.js?v=14"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/player.js?v=110"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  var $ = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
  var ROOTS = ["C","D♭","D","E♭","E","F","F♯","G","A♭","A","B♭","B"];
  var ROMAN = ["I","II","III","IV","V","VI","VII"];
  var LOWER = { min:1, m6:1, min7:1, m7b5:1, dim7:1, dim:1, mmaj7:1, m9:1 };
  var RSUF = { maj:"", min:"", dim:"°", aug:"+", "7":"7", maj7:"maj7", min7:"7", m6:"6", m9:"9", m7b5:"ø", dim7:"°7", mmaj7:"(maj7)" };
  var INTERVALS = ["unison","minor 2nd","major 2nd","minor 3rd","major 3rd","perfect 4th","tritone","perfect 5th","minor 6th","major 6th","minor 7th","major 7th","octave"];
  var INVERSION = { 0: "root position", 3: "first inversion", 4: "first inversion", 7: "second inversion", 5: "second inversion", 8: "second inversion", 9: "first inversion (6th chord)", 10: "third inversion", 11: "third inversion" };

  var prevN = 0, kbOct = 3, down = {}, sticky = {}, last = null, recent = [], midiAccess = null, input = null, rootPc = null;
  function mod(n){ return ((n % 12) + 12) % 12; }
  function sharp(s){ return String(s).replace(/#/g, "♯").replace(/([A-G])b/g, "$1♭"); }

  // ---- the key: Do, and which note is home ----
  function detected(){                                    // the key the recent notes suggest
    if (recent.length < 3) return { tonicPc: 0, mode: "major", guess: false };
    var w = []; for (var i = 0; i < 12; i++) w.push(0);
    recent.forEach(function(pc, i){ w[pc] += 1 + i / recent.length; });
    var k = PitchSpelling.estimateKey(w); return { tonicPc: k.tonicPc, mode: k.mode, guess: true };
  }
  function key(){                                         // { doPc, mode, home, auto }
    var sel = $("cs-do").value, auto = sel === "auto", d;
    if (auto){ d = detected(); return { doPc: d.mode === "minor" ? mod(d.tonicPc + 3) : d.tonicPc, mode: d.mode, auto: true, guess: d.guess }; }
    var mode = $("cs-home").value, tonic = +sel;                     // the key note is the home note; a minor key's Do is a minor third above it
    return { doPc: mode === "minor" ? mod(tonic + 3) : tonic, mode: mode, auto: false };
  }
  function keyLof(k){ return PitchSpelling.keyTonicLOF(k.mode === "minor" ? mod(k.doPc + 9) : k.doPc); }
  function spell(pc, k){ return sharp(PitchSpelling.spellPitchClass(pc, keyLof(k)).name); }
  function homeOf(k){ return k.mode === "minor" ? mod(k.doPc + 9) : k.doPc; }
  function solOf(pc, k){ return DegreeNames.label(pc, { doPc: k.doPc, restPc: homeOf(k) }); }   // in the chosen system

  // ---- naming what is sounding ----
  function romanFor(res, k){
    var home = k.mode === "minor" ? mod(k.doPc + 9) : k.doPc, da = PitchSpelling.degreeForRoot(res.rootPc, home, k.mode);
    var n = ROMAN[da.degree - 1]; if (LOWER[res.quality]) n = n.toLowerCase();
    var acc = da.acc > 0 ? new Array(da.acc + 1).join("♯") : da.acc < 0 ? new Array(-da.acc + 1).join("♭") : "";
    var suf = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(RSUF, res.quality) ? RSUF[res.quality] : res.suffix.replace(/^m(?!aj)/, "");
    return acc + n + suf;
  }
  function sounding(){
    var set = {}; Object.keys(down).forEach(function(m){ set[m] = 1; }); Object.keys(sticky).forEach(function(m){ set[m] = 1; });
    return Object.keys(set).map(Number).sort(function(a, b){ return a - b; });
  }
  function describe(midis){
    var k = key(), out = { midis: midis, k: k, chord: "", sub: "", root: null };
    var pcs = []; midis.forEach(function(m){ var pc = mod(m); if (pcs.indexOf(pc) < 0) pcs.push(pc); });
    out.sol = pcs.map(function(pc){ return solOf(pc, k); }); out.names = pcs.map(function(pc){ return spell(pc, k); });
    if (midis.length === 1){
      out.chord = out.names[0]; out.sub = out.sol[0];
      out.root = pcs[0];
    } else if (pcs.length === 1){ out.chord = out.names[0]; out.sub = out.sol[0] + ", in more than one octave"; out.root = pcs[0]; }
    else {
      var res = pcs.length >= 3 ? ChordEntry.analyse(midis, { keyLof: keyLof(k) }) : null;
      if (res){
        var sym = ChordEntry.symbol(res, { keyLof: keyLof(k), slash: true });
        out.chord = sharp(sym); out.root = res.rootPc;
        var bass = mod(midis[0] - res.rootPc), inv = INVERSION[bass] || "";
        out.sub = romanFor(res, k) + "  ·  root " + solOf(res.rootPc, k) + (inv && bass ? "  ·  " + inv : "") + (res.exact ? "" : "  ·  closest name");
        out.roman = romanFor(res, k);
      } else if (pcs.length === 2){
        var d = midis[midis.length - 1] - midis[0]; out.chord = INTERVALS[d] || (INTERVALS[d % 12] + " and an octave");
        out.chord = out.chord.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + out.chord.slice(1);
        out.sub = out.sol[0] + " up to " + out.sol[out.sol.length - 1]; out.root = null;
      } else { out.chord = "No chord name"; out.sub = "These notes don't make a chord I know."; }
    }
    return out;
  }
  function show(){
    var now = sounding(), d;
    if (now.length){ d = describe(now); if (now.length >= prevN) last = d; }   // letting keys go does not replace the chord that was played
    else d = last;
    prevN = now.length;
    var read = $("cs-read").parentNode;
    read.classList.toggle("cs-ghost", !now.length && !!d);
    if (!d){ $("cs-chord").innerHTML = "&nbsp;"; $("cs-sub").textContent = "Play a note, or a chord."; $("cs-sol").textContent = ""; $("cs-names").textContent = ""; rootPc = null; }
    else {
      d = now.length ? d : describe(d.midis);                      // a ghost is re-read in the key as it is now
      $("cs-chord").textContent = d.chord;
      $("cs-sub").innerHTML = DegreeNames.html(d.sub + (now.length ? "" : "  ·  last played"));
      $("cs-sol").innerHTML = d.sol.map(function(s){ return "<span>" + DegreeNames.html(s) + "</span>"; }).join(" ");
      $("cs-names").innerHTML = d.names.map(function(s){ return "<span>" + s + "</span>"; }).join(" ");
      rootPc = d.root;
    }
    var k = key();
    var homeName = spell(homeOf(k), k) + (k.mode === "minor" ? " minor" : " major");
    $("cs-keyline").textContent = k.auto ? (k.guess ? "Key from your playing: " + homeName + ". Set the key note below to fix it." : "The key is C major until you play enough notes to tell. Set the key note below to fix it.")
                                         : "Key: " + homeName + ".";
    $("cs-home").disabled = k.auto;
    lights();
  }
  function remember(m){ recent.push(mod(m)); if (recent.length > 24) recent.shift(); }

  // ---- the keys ----
  var WHITE = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
  function lo(){ return 12 * (kbOct + 1); }
  function build(){
    var box = $("cs-kb"); box.innerHTML = "";
    var first = lo(), count = 36, nW = 22, wi = {}, i = 0;
    for (var m = first; m <= first + count; m++) if (WHITE.indexOf(mod(m)) >= 0) wi[m] = i++;
    var ww = 100 / nW;
    for (m = first; m <= first + count; m++){
      var black = WHITE.indexOf(mod(m)) < 0, b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button"; b.className = "cs-k " + (black ? "b" : "w"); b.setAttribute("data-midi", m); b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
      b.style.left = (black ? (wi[m - 1] + 1) * ww - ww * 0.3 : wi[m] * ww) + "%"; b.style.width = (black ? ww * 0.6 : ww) + "%";
      b.innerHTML = "<b></b><i></i>"; box.appendChild(b);
    }
    labels(); lights();
    $("cs-oct-lab").textContent = "C" + kbOct + " – C" + (kbOct + 3);
  }
  function labels(){
    var k = key(), mode = $("cs-label").value;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call($("cs-kb").children, function(b){
      var m = +b.getAttribute("data-midi"), pc = mod(m);
      b.firstChild.innerHTML = mode === "sol" || mode === "both" ? DegreeNames.html(solOf(pc, k)) : mode === "names" ? spell(pc, k) : "";
      b.lastChild.textContent = mode === "both" ? spell(pc, k) : "";
      b.classList.toggle("do", mod(pc - k.doPc) === 0);
      b.setAttribute("aria-label", spell(pc, k) + Math.floor(m / 12 - 1) + ", " + solOf(pc, k));
    });
  }
  function lights(){
    var on = {}; sounding().forEach(function(m){ on[m] = 1; });
    var k = key();
    Array.prototype.forEach.call($("cs-kb").children, function(b){
      var m = +b.getAttribute("data-midi"); b.classList.toggle("on", !!on[m]); b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", on[m] ? "true" : "false");
      b.classList.toggle("root", rootPc != null && !!on[m] && mod(m) === rootPc && Object.keys(on).length > 1);
    });
    labels();
  }

  // ---- notes in: the on-screen keys, the computer keyboard, MIDI ----
  function sound(m, vel){
    if (!$("cs-sound").checked) return;
    $("cs-note").textContent = "";
    BandPlayer.chord([m], { inst: "piano", dur: 3, vel: Math.max(0.25, Math.min(1, vel)) }).catch(function(){ $("cs-note").textContent = "Couldn't load the piano sounds. Check your connection and try again."; });
  }
  function noteOn(m, vel){ down[m] = 1; remember(m); sound(m, vel); show(); }
  function noteOff(m){ delete down[m]; show(); }
  function toggle(m, vel){ if (sticky[m]){ delete sticky[m]; show(); } else { sticky[m] = 1; remember(m); sound(m, vel); show(); } }
  function releaseAll(){ down = {}; sticky = {}; typing.releaseAll(); show(); }

  var pointers = {};
  $("cs-kb").addEventListener("pointerdown", function(e){
    var b = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".cs-k") : null; if (!b) return;
    e.preventDefault(); var m = +b.getAttribute("data-midi");
    if ($("cs-hold").checked){ toggle(m, 0.7); return; }
    pointers[e.pointerId] = m; noteOn(m, 0.7);
  });
  function up(e){ var m = pointers[e.pointerId]; if (m == null) return; delete pointers[e.pointerId]; noteOff(m); }
  document.addEventListener("pointerup", up); document.addEventListener("pointercancel", up);

  var typing = MusicalTyping.attach({
    onOn: function(m, vel){ noteOn(m, vel); }, onOff: function(m){ noteOff(m); },
    onOctave: function(o){ kbOct = o; build(); typeNote(); }, enabled: function(){ return $("cs-type").checked; }, octave: kbOct });
  function typeNote(){
    $("cs-type-note").textContent = $("cs-type").checked ? "Computer keyboard: the Z row starts on C" + kbOct + " and the Q row on C" + (kbOct + 1) + ". Arrow Up and Arrow Down change the octave." : "";
  }

  function onMidi(e){ var d = e.data, cmd = d[0] & 0xf0;
    if (cmd === 0x90 && d[2] > 0) noteOn(d[1], d[2] / 127); else if (cmd === 0x80 || cmd === 0x90) noteOff(d[1]); }
  function inputs(){
    var sel = $("cs-midi"), want = sel.value, list = [];
    midiAccess.inputs.forEach(function(i){ list.push(i); });
    sel.innerHTML = ""; (list.length ? list.map(function(i){ return { id: i.id, label: i.name || "MIDI input" }; }) : [{ id: "", label: "No MIDI keyboard found" }])
      .forEach(function(it){ var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = it.id; o.textContent = it.label; sel.appendChild(o); });
    sel.disabled = !list.length;
    if (list.some(function(i){ return i.id === want; })) sel.value = want;
    if (input) input.onmidimessage = null;
    input = list.filter(function(i){ return i.id === sel.value; })[0] || null;
    if (input) input.onmidimessage = onMidi;
    $("cs-note").textContent = input ? "Listening to " + (input.name || "the MIDI keyboard") + "." : "No MIDI keyboard found. Plug one in, or use the keys.";
  }
  $("cs-connect").addEventListener("click", function(){
    if (!navigator.requestMIDIAccess){ $("cs-note").textContent = "This browser cannot read a MIDI keyboard (Safari, iPhone and iPad cannot). Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or the keys on screen."; return; }
    navigator.requestMIDIAccess().then(function(a){ midiAccess = a; a.onstatechange = inputs; inputs(); },
      function(){ $("cs-note").textContent = "The browser did not allow MIDI. Allow it for this site, or use the keys on screen."; });
  });
  $("cs-midi").addEventListener("change", function(){ if (midiAccess) inputs(); });

  // ---- wiring ----
  (function(){ var sel = $("cs-do"), o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = "auto"; o.textContent = "Found from what I play"; sel.appendChild(o);
    ROOTS.forEach(function(n, i){ var p = document.createElement("option"); p.value = i; p.textContent = n; sel.appendChild(p); }); })();
  function words(){                                       // the labels that name the system
    var t = DegreeNames.term();
    $("cs-solth").textContent = t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1);
  }
  DegreeNames.bind($("cs-sys")); words();
  DegreeNames.onChange(function(){ words(); show(); });
  try { var was = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("chordsSolfege2") || "{}");
    if (was.d != null) $("cs-do").value = was.d; if (was.h) $("cs-home").value = was.h; if (was.l) $("cs-label").value = was.l; } catch (e) {}
  function keep(){ try { localStorage.setItem("chordsSolfege2", JSON.stringify({ d: $("cs-do").value, h: $("cs-home").value, l: $("cs-label").value })); } catch (e) {} }
  ["cs-do", "cs-home", "cs-label"].forEach(function(id){ $(id).addEventListener("change", function(){ keep(); $(id).blur(); show(); }); });
  $("cs-hold").addEventListener("change", function(){ releaseAll(); $("cs-hold").blur(); });
  $("cs-type").addEventListener("change", function(){ typing.releaseAll(); typeNote(); });
  $("cs-clear").addEventListener("click", releaseAll);
  $("cs-oct-dn").addEventListener("click", function(){ typing.setOctave(kbOct - 1); });
  $("cs-oct-up").addEventListener("click", function(){ typing.setOctave(kbOct + 1); });
  window.addEventListener("pagehide", releaseAll);
  build(); typeNote(); show();
  window.__cs = { on: noteOn, off: noteOff, toggle: toggle, now: function(){ return last; }, state: function(){ return { chord: $("cs-chord").textContent, sub: $("cs-sub").textContent, sol: $("cs-sol").textContent, key: $("cs-keyline").textContent }; } };
})();
</script>
```
